note: biome set: draw with the global sheets, variants and cliffs plus these; a biome variant list replaces the global one for its terrain; palette = the global palette (first entries, unchanged) + this biome's colours
mask: NW<<3|NE<<2|SW<<1|SE, set bit = first terrain; frame index = mask; NW is the top vertex

anchor.note: top vertex of the top diamond

variants.note: full scree tiles; wherever a sheet would draw the full scree tile, draw frame hash(x, y) % frames instead; frame 0 = that tile; all frames share its outer band, so they sit next to any transition tile

full meadow tiles; wherever a sheet would draw the full meadow tile, draw frame hash(x, y) % frames instead; frame 0 = that tile; all frames share its outer band, so they sit next to any transition tile

full gravel tiles; wherever a sheet would draw the full gravel tile, draw frame hash(x, y) % frames instead; frame 0 = that tile; all frames share its outer band, so they sit next to any transition tile

full drift tiles; wherever a sheet would draw the full drift tile, draw frame hash(x, y) % frames instead; frame 0 = that tile; all frames share its outer band, so they sit next to any transition tile
full rock tiles; wherever a sheet would draw the full rock tile, draw frame hash(x, y) % frames instead; frame 0 = that tile; all frames share its outer band, so they sit next to any transition tile

fallback.note: Same rule as the global tiles.json fallback, over the global sheets plus these (land buffer grass). Mountain pairs with a sheet: grass-scree, grass-meadow, grass-gravel, grass-snow, rock-scree (plus the global grass-rock, rock-snow, road-rock); others (scree-snow, meadow-rock, gravel-rock, ...) get a grass verge.

cliffs.note: tall cliff face (W-51 crag kit): frames of 64x32 in a row, each one 2 m level of the left + right faces (top edge along the lower half of the diamond); roles: lip = the top level under a cliff edge, face = the levels below it, low = the lowest levels; pick a frame per (tile, level) by hash inside its role, frame 0 is a face (a reader of the first 64 px draws a plain cliff)

cliffs.material: grey granite, snow on the ledges
